description_en: Queries the time when an AccessKey pair was used for the last time
description_zh: 查询某个指定访问密钥的最后使用时间
kebab_example: aliyun ims get-access-key-last-used --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --user-access-key-id LTAI0000000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAccessKeyLastUsed

parameters.help_en:
The logon name of the RAM user.

If you do not specify this parameter, the AccessKey pair of the current user is queried
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的登录名称。

如果为空，默认查询当前用户的访问密钥
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AccessKey pair that you want to query
parameters.name: user_access_key_id
